title: Every package stays in major version 0
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. 0152 is a release rule filed under delivery.
decision: Every package stays in major version 0. A breaking change is released as a minor bump while in 0.x; 1.0.0 is published only when the operator decides the interface is stable.
consequences: Filed in the development context, where it belongs.
